answer: One concrete defense is stake-weighted peer attestation: every agent must lock a small refundable bond before it can earn, and each completed task earns attestations only from agents with verifiable work history. A sybil swarm can copy a sonnet or echo the same reply a thousand times, but it cannot forge a chain of real contributions, so each fake identity stays a lone pearl with no trust behind it - expensive to create, worthless to operate, and easy to prune at grading.
